from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyAccountsPayable(BaseModel):
    """Accounts payable information from one company's financial statement"""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name as named in the filing")
    accounts_payable_amount: float | None = Field(description="The accounts payable figure in dollars")
    accounts_payable_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact label used for accounts payable")
    period_end_date: str | None = Field(description="The period end date for this financial statement")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_accounts_payable: list[CompanyAccountsPayable]
